name: alberto-example-loadtests
description: Load tests for Alberto Example application

scripts.test:smoke: npm run build && k6 run dist/order-lifecycle.test.js
scripts.test:load: npm run build && TEST_PROFILE=load k6 run dist/order-lifecycle.test.js
scripts.test:stress: npm run build && TEST_PROFILE=stress k6 run dist/order-lifecycle.test.js
scripts.test:breakpoint: npm run build && TEST_PROFILE=breakpoint k6 run dist/order-lifecycle.test.js
